cues.text: A green sky. A winged figure rises toward the moon.
Red cracks spread across its face.
It breaks apart into jagged rock.
Inside, a vast red eye opens.
Far below, the group stands, looking up.
The winged figure flies into the glare.
The town below. Coffins stand in the streets, beside pools of blood.
Now people stand in their place.
The glowing tower looms over the dark city.
A beam joins the tower's peak to the sky. Red water below.
